men.summary: At 1-0 with a home win and no conference or Quadrant 1 games played, the Bluejays have almost no résumé to judge, and the data is contradictory: a 4-6 last-10 record can't coexist with a one-game season, and an RPI of 1 doesn't square with a NET of 83. Until Big East results arrive, the postseason outlook is undetermined, though a NET of 83 would leave them well outside typical at-large range for now.

women.summary: With a 1-0 record built on a Quadrant 1 road win, the Bluejays are still waiting to open Big East play (0-0), and their No. 1 RPI is a small-sample artifact next to a NET ranking of 91. The postseason outlook is wide open, since the listed 7-3 mark over the last 10 games conflicts with a 1-0 record and can't be trusted, and a NET of 91 means they'll need a strong conference run to build an at-large case.
